scope: Systems inventory for original Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team (GBA) / Blue Rescue Team (DS), excluding Rescue Team DX
evidence_policy: Original Nintendo instruction manuals were preferred. Nintendo-hosted PDF URLs were identified; mirrored copies were readable and Red controls were checked against a page screenshot. Bulbapedia version-specific sections supplied exact mechanics. Recommendations are implementation inferences, not claims that a recreation is complete.

sources.title: Rescue Team:Version Differences
sources.note: Version comparison reference; not fully inspected

verified_facts: A move, attack, or item use advances dungeon turns; while the player waits for input, enemies wait. Menus and facing controls need separate non-action handling.
Red: D-pad moves; A attacks/talks; B opens menu; B+D-pad runs; START changes facing without moving; SELECT shows map/sorts/sets moves; R+D-pad constrains diagonal movement.
Both versions: L+A uses the set move, L+B opens message history, L+R throws the set projectile, A+B passes turns.
Blue: X also opens menu; Y changes facing; START shows detail in applicable menus. Touch controls support pointing, moving, talking, selected attacks, and throwing. Top screen can show map/team/log.
A 3D camera is a presentation change: tile coordinates, facing, movement eligibility and action timing remain independent.
uncertainty: Exact internal ordering among individual allies and enemies, speed subturns, and every free-versus-turn-consuming menu operation requires deeper engine verification.

verified_facts: Dungeon rooms, corridors, stairs, enemies, and loot vary between visits. Map marks leader, allies, foes, items and stairs.
Stairs and warp zones move forward; original games process enemy turns before stairs interaction.
Monster Houses are rooms that trigger a mass enemy appearance on entry.
Species mobility determines access to water, lava, air and walls. Wall-travel can cost 5 Belly per step.
Straight projectiles generally stop at walls, the first target or ten tiles; rock-like projectiles arc over walls.
Original team capacity is four, with further dungeon restrictions possible.
uncertainty: Exact dungeon generation distributions, visibility geometry, weather intervals and floor timeout thresholds not exhaustively verified in this pass.

verified_facts: Four learned move slots plus a separate typeless regular attack. Original regular attack uses Attack/Defense, power 1, accuracy 93%, natural critical rate 0%; it consumes no PP.
Original level-up learnsets derive from FireRed/LeafGreen. Moves have dungeon-specific PP, ranges, power, accuracy, targets and effects.
STAB=1.5; super-effective=1.5, resisted=0.9, nominal type immunity=0.5; dual-type factors multiply. Ability immunity can still negate an attack. Critical multiplier=1.5.
Participating party members share experience; a defeat without a qualifying move yields half experience; linked moves give a 50% experience bonus. Environmental defeats give none.

Linked sets execute top-to-bottom in one turn, spend each move's PP, and unlink when one runs out. Two-turn/recharging moves cannot link. Manual delink is available; Gulpin costs 150 Poké; Link Box works in dungeons.
uncertainty: Do not use the Explorers damage formula shown on the generic battle page as if proven for RB. Complete move data, 17-type chart edge cases and damage rounding remain a dataset/research task.

verified_facts: No IVs, EVs or nature stat bonuses. Species/level stat tables govern growth; original HP cap 999 and other stat caps 255.
Normal HP regeneration is 0.5% maximum HP per turn. Poison, bad poison, Nightmare and empty Belly prevent it.
Belly begins at 100, ordinary actions consume 0.1, and linked sets of two/three/four moves consume 1/2/3.
At zero Belly, leader loses 1 HP per turn, cannot run or use linked moves. Empty-Belly nonleaders become immobile and deal 1 damage.

Apple restores 50; at full Belly raises capacity 5. Big Apple restores 100; full-Belly capacity gain 10. Huge Apple fills Belly and raises capacity 10. Capacity growth is temporary for the expedition, capped at 200.
Oran Berry heals 100 HP; Sitrus heals fully or raises maximum HP by 2 if already full. Max Elixir restores all move PP.
minimum_interactions: stat stage reset by floor/Wonder Tile
uncertainty: Full food/seed/drink effect table and fractional rounding should be separately checked.

verified_facts: Multiple status categories coexist, but statuses within some categories replace one another; floor changes clear ailments.

Original Sleep lasts 3–6 turns; Frozen 4–5; Paralysis 2–3 and blocks attacks/orbs while slowing movement. Poison deals 4 damage initially then every 10 turns; bad poison 6 initially then every 2; burn 5 initially then every 20 and lowers damage 20%.
Confusion redirects movement/attacks and can hit allies; thrown items are not redirected. Petrify persists until affected, with finite leader duration.
Hidden traps reveal on contact or a regular attack aimed at their tile. Ordinary enemies do not trigger naturally generated traps. Most original traps remain reusable.
Original named traps: Chestnut, Explosion, Grimy, Gust, Mud, Pitfall, Poison, Pokémon, PP-Zero, Seal, Selfdestruct, Slow, Slumber, Spin, Sticky, Summon, Warp.
Most trap varieties belong to post-credits dungeons. Wonder Tiles reset stat stages.
uncertainty: Not every trap probability, trap damage radius, status immunity, timer or stacking exception was validated. Avoid treating all ailment timers as interchangeable.

verified_facts: Toolbox holds 20 item slots; held items and projectile stacks need distinct representations.
Defeat loses carried money and some items, preserves experience; deposits remain protected.
Home bed supports normal saving. Dungeon quicksave is consumed on resume; give-up follows defeat behavior.
Kangaskhan stores up to 999 of each item and takes reward overflow.
uncertainty: Exact retained-item selection on ordinary defeat, special theft defeat, and Reviver Seed/held-item priority need additional verification.

verified_facts: Recruitment unlocks after Mt. Steel when Friend Areas become available.
Leader must directly deliver the finishing blow with the target adjacent; poison/environmental KO is insufficient. Some cutscene legendary recruits have exceptions.
Required Friend Area, positive effective chance, party room and body-size room are necessary. Party max four; combined body size max six, subject to stricter dungeon rules.
New recruits must survive until successful exit/warp; if they or the leader faint beforehand they are not retained.
Many evolved species cannot be directly recruited; story bosses commonly cannot recruit on first battle.
uncertainty: Per-species base rates, specific legendary automatic-area exceptions and unrecruitable floors are not enumerated here.

verified_facts: Friend Areas are explorable homes for recruits, reached west of Team Base; original capacity totals 413 for 386 species plus Unown forms.
Acquisition uses purchases, job rewards and special recruits. Hero/partner have associated starting homes.
Initial Wigglytuff event provides Mist-Rise Forest, Wild Plains, then Power Plant for Magnemite.
uncertainty: Full 58-area costs/capacities/species assignment and story purchase availability require data extraction.

verified_facts: All Pokémon use the same 23 original IQ skills, starting at IQ 1. At most 12 active: five unrestricted plus one from each of seven groups.
Gummis add IQ by type: same=7, strong-against=4, neutral=3, resisted=2, immune=1; dual types add both results.

Thresholds: 1 Item Catcher/Course Checker/Dedicated Traveler/Item Master/Exclusive Move-User; 2 PP Checker; 10 Efficiency Expert; 25 Status Checker; 40 Nontraitor; 70 Self-Curer; 100 Quick Dodger; 105 Type-Advantage Master; 125 Weak-Type Picker; 140 Trap Avoider; 160 Nonsleeper; 200 EXP. Go-Getter; 250 Energy Saver; 300 Lava Evader; 400 All-Terrain Hiker; 500 Sure-Hit Attacker; 600 Trap Seer; 800 House Avoider; 990 Super Mobile.
Ally tactics and allowed moves are player settings; tactic availability grows with leader level.
uncertainty: Tactic-by-level table and every IQ group mapping not fully extracted; EXP. Go-Getter has a documented original targeting bug.

verified_facts: Unlocked after Sky Tower/main-story completion. Evolution is voluntary at Luminous Cave in Whiscash Pond and requires a solo party.
Level requirements remain; trade evolutions use Link Cable, sometimes plus an item; friendship uses species-specific IQ; day/night use Sun/Lunar Ribbon; Feebas uses Beauty Scarf.
Original evolution provides no immediate stat increase and removes progress toward the next level while retaining current level.
Cave asks whether to evolve and whether to provide items; it explains unmet requirements and returns supplied items if evolution fails.
uncertainty: Full species evolution table, Tyrogue and Shedinja edge cases require per-species validation.

verified_facts: Up to eight board jobs, four mailbox jobs, eight accepted jobs. Accepting and activating are separate; only one job per floor and one escort at once.
Original job types: rescue, escort, deliver specified item, find item, plus special story requests. Outlaw jobs are absent.
Escort client defeat fails expedition. Find-item jobs can complete with an already-owned item upon exiting.
Hidden difficulty 1–15 determines points: [5,10,20,40,60,80,100,150,200,300,500,700,1000,1500,2000]. Letter grades group multiple difficulties, so D is not always 10 and C is not always 20.
Ranks: Normal 0, Bronze 50, Silver 500, Gold 1500, Platinum 3000, Diamond 7500, Lucario 15000. Lucario awards a base figure.
Job rewards include Poké/items and sometimes Friend Areas. Rank letter money begins E=100 and rises by 100 per grade. Escort adds two hidden difficulty levels, capped at 15.
uncertainty: Precise high-difficulty letter grouping and reward pools must be preserved from the table, not inferred from flattened search output. Friend Area reward eligibility is marked incomplete by source.

verified_facts: Green Kecleon sells consumables/equipment; purple sells TMs/orbs/keys. Stock changes with progress and excursions.
Persian's Felicity Bank deposits/withdraws Poké; Kangaskhan stores/retrieves items; Wigglytuff sells Friend Areas; Gulpin links/relearns for 150 Poké.
Pelipper Post Office handles jobs and rescue mail. Whiscash Pond supplies story interactions and postgame evolution.
Dungeon Kecleon shops appear from Mt. Blaze onward. Pick up then pay; place then sell. Leaving unpaid creates hostile level-90 Kecleon and reinforcements, blocks normal Escape Orb/rescue behavior.
Makuhita has 21 three-floor preset mazes, bosses on third floors. Six initial types after Friend Areas; four more after mailbox invasion; six after Mt. Freeze; Ghost/team mazes after credits.
Clearing all 17 type mazes awards Bonsly figure and Ginseng. First team-maze clears award Ginseng. Shops and jobs refresh after maze clears; normal maze encounters are not recruitable.
uncertainty: Town NPC dialogue should be newly written summaries, not copied scripts. Full shop stock probabilities and every maze enemy roster are separate data tasks.

verified_facts: Original quiz asks eight category-distinct questions, then gender; one question can generate an extra follow-up. Scores select a nature and gender/nature selects species.
Male-only quiz results: Meowth, Machop, Cyndaquil. Female-only: Eevee, Chikorita, Skitty.
Partner pool: Bulbasaur, Charmander, Squirtle, Pikachu, Chikorita, Cyndaquil, Totodile, Treecko, Torchic, Mudkip; excludes hero's type.
uncertainty: Exact question wording is deliberately not reproduced; exact question scores/tie-breaking require a dataset if authentic behavior is requested. Direct manual species override would be a declared adaptation, not original behavior.

verified_facts: Wonder Mail shares generated jobs: international codes have 24 characters (2×12), Japanese 17. Each code redeems once per save; locked ordinary dungeons still cannot be attempted.
Oddity Cave, Remains Island, Marvelous Sea, Fantasy Strait unlock through special Wonder Mail.
Friend Rescue becomes available with Mt. Steel. International SOS/A-OK mail is 51 characters (3×17); Japanese 34, incompatible with international codes.
Rescue flow: faint/request SOS, another team reaches rescue spot, returns A-OK, victim revives; optional Thank-You Mail. Helper Pokémon transfer requires cable/wireless, not just password.
Red uses GBA link cable; Blue uses DS wireless/touchscreen/second-screen status. Cross-version communication can use passwords.
Red wild exclusives include Feebas, Mantine, Roselia, Porygon, Plusle; Blue includes Magikarp, Lapras, Aipom, Minun; wild Porygon2 is Blue-only. Wonder Mail can unlock counterpart encounters.
Blue dual-slot Receive Team imports Red's current team as Rescue Team Maze boss.
uncertainty: Do not advertise cartridge-compatible passwords without implementing and checking original encoding/checksums. Exact full version-exclusive list including evolutionary availability needs careful definition. Dual-slot extras cannot be literally reproduced by standalone HTML; an explicit save-import adaptation is needed.

implementation_priority: First establish one complete, honest turn-based dungeon loop with movement, partner AI, PP, Belly, items, rescue objective, exit, failure and save.
Then make every town service and repeated-job loop actionable.
Then add recruitment, Friend Areas, IQ, linking, evolution and exact story gating.
Content completeness requires all species/moves/items/dungeon tables and all story/postgame events; rendering the roster or location names is not equivalent.
Single HTML can embed data and browser storage, but external model/CDN dependencies violate strict offline self-containment unless bundled.
high_risk_accuracy_pitfalls: Using DX's eight-party count, camps menu, rare qualities, auto-explore or rank-based bag upgrades.
Using Explorers' 1.4 super-effective multiplier instead of original 1.5.
Using modern physical/special move categorization without verifying original type-based rules.
Recruiting after partner kills or distant KOs; ignoring Friend Areas/body size/new-recruit survival.
Treating evolution as automatic at level-up or providing DX Evolution Crystals.
Awarding one fixed rescue-point amount per letter grade.
Presenting invented short local share codes as compatible Wonder Mail.
Calling an abbreviated campaign or generic procedural floors a full exact recreation.
remaining_research: Authoritative exact damage arithmetic, action scheduler, speed subturns and AI rules.
Complete original species stats/learnsets/abilities/body sizes/recruit rates/Friend Area mappings.
All 17 original type rows and physical/special classification; move PP/power/range/status data.
Complete original item effects, evolution requirements, IQ restrictions, tactics thresholds.
Original password algorithms and checksums if compatibility is in scope.
Precise postgame side-event prerequisites and all unique boss recruitment conditions.
